test_dimensions_class: test the chex Dimensions class with parameterized test cases for shape mapping
create_named_shape_mapping: create a Dimensions object mapping letters like B T N to integer shape sizes
resolve_named_shape_tuple: resolve a named shape string like BTN to its corresponding tuple of dimension sizes
compute_dimension_product: compute the flat product size of named dimensions using the size method
flatten_axes_with_parentheses: flatten multiple axes together by wrapping dimension names in parentheses in the key string
